column1: # clues.tsv for ft_isprint -- pedagogic hints only: each line is a QUESTION, never the expected value or the fix.
# Format: <hint><TAB><CASE label><TAB>...   (a line fires if ANY of its cases fails)

man isprint says "any printable character including space": which codes does man ascii show as printable, from which to which? What does p.8 say a classification function returns for a character in its class?
Is a control code printable? Is DEL (0x7f)? Is one of your bounds off by one?

man ascii lists 128 characters, the last one 0x7f: is a code above it in any class of the "C" locale, the one a program runs in until it calls setlocale()? (man 3 toupper, NOTES, says what that locale knows of umlauts.) Does your class have an upper end, and does your function check it?
Which value does <stdio.h> give EOF, and is that value the code of any character?
